<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1080 1920"><style>svg text{font-family:Inter,Arial,sans-serif;font-kerning:normal;} svg .heavy{font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-3px} svg .medium{font-weight:650;letter-spacing:-.5px}</style>
<defs>
 <pattern id="grid" width="52" height="52" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><path d="M52 0H0V52" stroke="#ccd0cc" stroke-width="1" fill="none" opacity=".24"/></pattern>
 <filter id="shadow" x="-30%" y="-40%" width="160%" height="190%"><feDropShadow dx="0" dy="18" stdDeviation="23" flood-color="#1F3038" flood-opacity=".15"/></filter>
 <filter id="mild" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%"><feDropShadow dx="0" dy="12" stdDeviation="15" flood-color="#1F3038" flood-opacity=".12"/></filter>
 <linearGradient id="shiny" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#313c43"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#1d2831"/></linearGradient>
 <clipPath id="monitorClip"><rect x="172" y="764" width="736" height="442" rx="13"/></clipPath>
</defs>
<rect width="1080" height="1920" fill="#F7F7F5" id="element_001"/><rect width="1080" height="1920" fill="url(#grid)" id="element_002"/>
<circle id="blob1" cx="1040" cy="620" r="370" fill="#f2e4dd" opacity=".27"/>
<circle cx="60" cy="1510" r="330" fill="#e8eef0" opacity=".25" id="element_003"/>
<!-- constant minimal editorial brand -->
<g id="micro" opacity="0"><rect x="92" y="261" width="9" height="30" rx="4" fill="#DF805F" id="element_004"/><text x="117" y="285" class="medium" font-size="25" fill="#646b6c" id="element_005">EASY2BOOT</text><text x="990" y="285" text-anchor="end" font-size="24" font-weight="650" fill="#a3a9a9" id="element_006">01 / MASALAH</text></g>
<g id="footer" opacity="0"><path d="M90 1535 H990" stroke="#E1E2DE" stroke-width="2" id="element_007"/><rect x="90" y="1571" width="0" height="6" rx="3" fill="#DF805F" id="timebar"/><text x="90" y="1617" font-size="23" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="1.4" fill="#929898" id="element_008">EASY2BOOT — SATU USB, BANYAK PILIHAN</text><text x="990" y="1617" font-size="24" font-weight="700" text-anchor="end" fill="#aab0af" id="element_009">01/06</text></g>
<!-- Layout A: visual need first, no static laptop entire time -->
<g id="A" opacity="0">
 <g id="aheadline"><text x="92" y="415" font-size="57" class="medium" fill="#7e8787" id="element_010">MAU INSTAL</text><text x="87" y="540" font-size="111" class="heavy" fill="#202628" id="element_011">WINDOWS <tspan fill="#DF805F">11?</tspan></text></g>
 <g id="adev" filter="url(#shadow)">
  <rect x="138" y="694" width="804" height="552" rx="32" fill="url(#shiny)" id="element_012"/>
  <rect x="157" y="711" width="766" height="518" rx="15" fill="#111d28" id="element_013"/>
  <g clip-path="url(#monitorClip)" id="element_014">
   <rect x="172" y="764" width="736" height="442" fill="#edf2f5" id="element_015"/>
   <rect x="172" y="764" width="736" height="46" fill="#fcfcfd" id="element_016"/>
   <circle cx="203" cy="789" r="6" fill="#d6dfe3" id="element_017"/><circle cx="227" cy="789" r="6" fill="#d6dfe3" id="element_018"/>
   <text x="265" y="797" font-size="20" fill="#78858e" font-weight="650" id="element_019">File Explorer</text>
   <rect x="231" y="856" width="623" height="277" rx="19" fill="white" stroke="#e0e7ec" stroke-width="2" id="element_020"/>
   <text x="277" y="901" font-size="23" font-weight="700" fill="#99a3a7" id="element_021">INSTALLER YANG DIBUTUHKAN</text>
   <g transform="translate(290 970)" fill="#1283cd" id="element_022"><path d="M0 0L52-6V48H0Z" id="element_023"/><path d="M62-8L124-15V48H62Z" id="element_024"/><path d="M0 59H52V113L0 107Z" id="element_025"/><path d="M62 59H124V120L62 113Z" id="element_026"/></g>
   <text x="446" y="1031" font-weight="800" letter-spacing="-2" font-size="67" fill="#222e35" id="element_027">Windows 11</text>
   <text x="446" y="1081" font-size="23" font-weight="600" fill="#8b98a2" id="element_028">Siap untuk instalasi</text>
  </g>
  <path d="M105 1244H975L1010 1298Q1015 1306 998 1313H82Q67 1306 73 1298Z" fill="#ced6d9" id="element_029"/>
  <path d="M105 1244H975L998 1298H82Z" fill="#edeff1" id="element_030"/><path d="M410 1254H670L687 1270H397Z" fill="#d9dfe2" id="element_031"/>
 </g>
 <g id="afile" filter="url(#mild)" transform="translate(0 0)">
  <rect x="626" y="1196" width="342" height="129" rx="20" fill="white" stroke="#E6E9EB" stroke-width="3" id="element_032"/>
  <rect x="654" y="1223" width="57" height="72" rx="8" fill="#E8F2F8" id="element_033"/>
  <path d="M667 1236H698M667 1249H699M667 1262H689" stroke="#3F8CBD" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" id="element_034"/>
  <text x="734" y="1251" font-size="37" font-weight="800" fill="#28333A" id="element_035">WIN 11</text>
  <text x="735" y="1290" font-size="22" font-weight="700" fill="#939C9F" id="element_036">INSTALLER</text>
 </g>
</g>
<!-- B: match-move: desired file vs actual flash drive -->
<g id="B" opacity="0">
 <g id="bheadline"><text x="91" y="409" font-size="55" class="medium" fill="#7e8787" id="element_037">TAPI USB-NYA...</text><text x="87" y="537" font-size="108" class="heavy" fill="#202628" id="element_038">WINDOWS <tspan fill="#DF805F">10.</tspan></text></g>
 <g id="bneeded" filter="url(#mild)">
  <rect x="100" y="735" width="445" height="177" rx="25" fill="white" stroke="#e5e8e8" stroke-width="3" id="element_039"/>
  <text x="139" y="781" font-size="22" font-weight="750" fill="#9AA3A5" id="element_040">DIBUTUHKAN</text>
  <text x="137" y="859" font-size="60" font-weight="850" fill="#263038" id="element_041">WIN <tspan fill="#DF805F">11</tspan></text>
  <path d="M449 817V855" stroke="#31A878" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round" id="element_042"/><path d="M430 839L449 858L478 823" stroke="#31A878" stroke-width="9" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" id="element_043"/>
 </g>
 <g id="bflash" filter="url(#shadow)">
  <rect x="207" y="1099" width="148" height="119" rx="9" fill="#c4cfd2" stroke="#9babb1" stroke-width="4" id="element_044"/>
  <rect x="233" y="1122" width="24" height="24" rx="3" fill="#91a2ab" id="element_045"/><rect x="298" y="1122" width="24" height="24" rx="3" fill="#91a2ab" id="element_046"/>
  <rect x="309" y="1029" width="597" height="260" rx="39" fill="url(#shiny)" id="element_047"/>
  <path d="M309 1068Q309 1029 348 1029H368V1289H348Q309 1289 309 1250Z" fill="#DF805F" id="element_048"/>
  <text x="403" y="1103" font-size="32" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="1" fill="#c2cdd3" id="element_049">FLASHDISK</text>
  <text x="395" y="1220" font-size="109" font-weight="850" letter-spacing="-4" fill="white" id="element_050">WIN 10</text>
 </g>
 <g id="bwrong"><circle cx="847" cy="898" r="76" fill="#fff1ea" stroke="#f8d8c9" stroke-width="3" id="element_051"/><path d="M815 864L879 932M879 864L815 932" stroke="#DF805F" stroke-width="14" stroke-linecap="round" id="element_052"/></g>
 <g id="bsub"><text x="539" y="1387" text-anchor="middle" font-size="31" font-weight="700" fill="#777E81" id="element_053">Installer tidak sesuai kebutuhan</text></g>
</g>
<!-- C: a brand-neutral UI mockup, different framing -->
<g id="C" opacity="0">
 <g id="cheadline"><text x="91" y="417" font-size="58" class="medium" fill="#7e8787" id="element_054">AKHIRNYA...</text><text x="86" y="541" font-size="110" class="heavy" fill="#202628" id="element_055">BUAT <tspan fill="#DF805F">ULANG?</tspan></text></g>
 <g id="cpanel" filter="url(#shadow)">
   <rect x="94" y="721" width="892" height="670" rx="31" fill="white" stroke="#E3E7E7" stroke-width="3" id="element_056"/>
   <path d="M94 752Q94 721 125 721H955Q986 721 986 752V795H94Z" fill="#F4F7F7" id="element_057"/>
   <circle cx="140" cy="758" r="10" fill="#d9b7ae" id="element_058"/><circle cx="174" cy="758" r="10" fill="#e3d5c8" id="element_059"/><circle cx="209" cy="758" r="10" fill="#c6d3d6" id="element_060"/>
   <text x="260" y="769" font-size="29" font-weight="740" fill="#536169" id="element_061">PEMBUAT USB BOOTABLE</text>
   <text x="151" y="866" font-size="26" font-weight="710" fill="#88939A" id="element_062">FLASHDISK</text>
   <rect x="145" y="890" width="790" height="84" rx="15" fill="#F6F8F9" stroke="#DFE6E9" stroke-width="2" id="element_063"/>
   <text x="185" y="943" font-size="34" font-weight="700" fill="#33424A" id="element_064">USB Drive (E:) — 32 GB</text><path d="M864 922L884 942L904 922" stroke="#6c777c" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" id="element_065"/>
   <text x="151" y="1046" font-size="26" font-weight="710" fill="#88939A" id="element_066">FILE ISO</text>
   <rect x="145" y="1074" width="790" height="90" rx="15" fill="#F6F8F9" stroke="#DFE6E9" stroke-width="2" id="element_067"/>
   <g transform="translate(184 1099)" id="element_068"><rect width="44" height="50" rx="7" fill="#dcebf6" id="element_069"/><path d="M12 16H34M12 26H34M12 36H24" stroke="#5696BB" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" id="element_070"/></g>
   <text id="isoName" x="252" y="1131" font-size="33" font-weight="720" fill="#33424A">Windows_11.iso</text>
   <rect id="startbtn" x="145" y="1217" width="790" height="106" rx="18" fill="#DF805F"/>
   <text x="540" y="1284" text-anchor="middle" font-size="37" font-weight="820" fill="white" id="element_071">MULAI MEMBUAT BOOTABLE</text>
 </g>
 <g id="ccursor"><path d="M0 0L0 67L18 50L32 87L52 80L36 46L61 46Z" fill="#263844" stroke="white" stroke-width="5" stroke-linejoin="round" id="element_072"/></g>
 <g id="cclick" opacity="0"><circle cx="600" cy="1260" r="36" fill="none" stroke="#DF805F" stroke-width="7" id="element_073"/></g>
</g>
<!-- D: distinct progress/completion frustration -->
<g id="D" opacity="0">
 <g id="dheadline"><text x="91" y="420" font-size="58" class="medium" fill="#7e8787" id="element_074">GANTI INSTALLER...</text><text x="86" y="541" font-size="113" class="heavy" fill="#202628" id="element_075">NUNGGU <tspan fill="#DF805F">LAGI.</tspan></text></g>
 <g id="dpanel" filter="url(#shadow)">
  <rect x="115" y="766" width="850" height="480" rx="31" fill="white" stroke="#e5e9e9" stroke-width="3" id="element_076"/>
  <g transform="translate(176 841)" id="element_077">
    <circle cx="38" cy="39" r="40" fill="#FFF0E9" id="element_078"/>
    <path d="M38 15V39L56 50" stroke="#DF805F" stroke-width="9" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" id="element_079"/>
  </g>
  <text x="284" y="879" font-size="39" font-weight="800" fill="#29343c" id="element_080">Membuat USB bootable...</text>
  <text x="176" y="992" font-size="29" font-weight="650" fill="#879397" id="element_081">Windows_11.iso</text>
  <rect x="174" y="1031" width="731" height="33" rx="16" fill="#EDF0EF" id="element_082"/>
  <rect x="174" y="1031" width="0" height="33" rx="16" fill="#DF805F" id="dbar"/>
  <text x="178" y="1146" font-size="29" font-weight="650" fill="#8B9398" id="element_083">Menyiapkan installer...</text>
  <text id="dpct" x="902" y="1159" font-size="72" font-weight="830" fill="#263238" text-anchor="end">0%</text>
 </g>
 <g id="dstop" opacity="0"><rect x="262" y="1319" width="560" height="82" rx="40" fill="#f8e9e3" id="element_084"/><text x="540" y="1375" font-size="34" font-weight="800" text-anchor="middle" fill="#BF7054" id="element_085">HARUS ULANG LAGI?</text></g>
</g>
</svg>
